ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels on visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous patch localized on the distal right lobe tip; secondary clusters of high-intensity white mottling located along the trailing edge margins proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate acute angle of 35-45 degrees relative to the lobe centerlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with variable pixel amplitudes (3-12 pixels) along the right lobe boundary; left lobe boundary serrations are partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading and outer margins of the right lobe; left lobe sweep follows an upward convex trajectory but is significantly masked by noise/spray.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of circular, high-contrast textured nodules (barnacle clusters) localized on the outer distal edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of calcified circular nodules on the right fluke tip; irregular pixel-level notches on the trailing edge consistent with physical material loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of pixel data in the lower-left and central regions caused by high-velocity water spray and droplet artifacts.
